mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports computational docking of samples A and B to histone deacetylase HDAC8; sample A conformers scored higher than sample B and the predicted contacts include hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, and pi-pi stacking depending on sample/conformer.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: c(Pro-Phe-Pro-Phe) sample A and c(Pro-Phe-Pro-D-Phe) sample B

source_locator.note: Molecular docking section and Figure 10 describe HDAC8 computational interactions.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Docking is computational only; no biochemical HDAC8 inhibition assay or binding assay is reported in the local primary material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MTT cell-viability testing supports limited cytotoxicity/no toxic effect for both cyclic tetrapeptides up to 100 µg/ml after 72 h in HaCaT, A431, and MDA-MB-231 cells.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: samples A and B in human cell viability assays

source_locator.note: Primary text states no toxic effects up to 100 µg/ml and HaCaT survival did not decrease below 80% after 72 h.

mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a toxicity phenotype, not a direct molecular mechanism of antimicrobial or anticancer action.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The local primary material does not report MIC/MBC antimicrobial assays or direct membrane/permeabilization mechanism experiments for samples A or B; background statements about cyclic peptide mechanisms are literature context only.

source_locator.note: Introduction contains background mechanism examples; Results/Experimental contain docking and cytotoxicity but no direct antimicrobial mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote cited background membrane-disruption language to a mechanism for this paper.

mechanism_summary: Mechanism layer is source-reviewed and bounded: HDAC8 interaction is computational-only, cytotoxicity is phenotype-supported, and no direct antimicrobial/membrane mechanism assay is locally reported.
